summary: Root must register the hand-written novel command groups (address, coverage, fleet, trip) with addNovelCommandIfAbsent; a fresh print does not emit these calls, and a regen that drops them makes the novel commands unreachable from the CLI and the MCP mirror.
reason: The generated root.go only wires endpoint and framework commands, so a reprint silently removes every batch command (address clean, trip quote, coverage check, fleet plan, address report and address dupes). regen-merge reports these as lost registrations and must restore them.
